notes: Seven web searches ran, none refused. Campaign issues page (https://rogersforflorida.com/issues/, undated, so not listed as a statement) says 'Austin, like President Trump, believes that America must win the race for Artificial Intelligence (AI)' and backs keeping AI innovation in the US and workforce training: also D. Same Florida Trib interview has him say 'we have to beat China and the AI race' and call for 'thoughtful leadership when it comes to artificial intelligence' (D). Quotes were read through a page-fetch tool that returns extracted text, so a reviewer should confirm exact wording. No sign he backs the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; as a representative-elect he signed none of the House letters. Not to be confused with Senate candidate Mike Rogers (rogersforsenate.com).
